thread:
marta: Quick release note: the community-run 'model-zoo-curation' repo just published v0.3.0 with a new tagging scheme (license, benchmark hints, provenance). Release notes + migration guide: https://github.com/redwood/model-zoo-curation/releases/tag/v0.3.0

lee: Nice! does this change the PR process for maintainers?

toni: Short answer: yes, some checklist items added for tags and provenance fields. The migration guide includes a small GH action to auto-fill legacy entries.

release-bot: Automated release created for tag v0.3.0 by marta. Changelog: added license tags, benchmark_hints, provenance_url, and schema bump to 1.2.

marta: We'll run a script next week to add missing license tags for repos that opted in; maintainers will get pings with suggested edits. If you do NOT want automated updates, DM me.

devrel: We'll update the community docs and send a newsletter blurb tomorrow. Also planning a 30min office hours next Wednesday to walk through the migration.

sasha: Can external contributors submit fixes to tagging via PRs?

toni: Yes — tagging changes are in a constrained schema; PRs welcome. We added a CONTRIBUTING note to reduce churn.

community-bot: Reminder: office hours - Wed 15:00 UTC (link in #community-events).

marta: TL;DR: model-zoo-curation v0.3.0 live -> new tags + migration guide. Check the release link and join office hours if you want help. Thanks all!
